title: What If You Jumped Through the Earth? 🌍 #shorts
description:
Would you jump? Comment yes or no.
A fall through a tunnel to the other side of the planet takes about 38 minutes, according to a physicist's calculation (no air, no heat assumed).

Sources: Live Science (2015), Phys.org, A. Klotz, American Journal of Physics 83, 231 (2015)
